newsitem.title: UK: London shares start mixed, seen in narrow range.
newsitem.headline: London shares start mixed, seen in narrow range.

text.p: UK shares started mixed to slightly higher on Thursday, with many investors expected to stay on the sidelines ahead of the long Easter weekend break.
The London financial markets, which are closed on Friday will not reopen for business until Tuesday, April 1.
"A lot of people will be starting their holiday early and those who are at their desks today will probably just watch their screens," the head of trading at a major brokerage said.
The FTSE 100 index of leading shares was up 3.1 points to 4,304.6 by 0835 GMT.
Dealers said a scarcity of corporate news Wall Street's Wednesday would limit the FTSE's upside on Thursday.
